transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for joining this placement review meeting. As you know, we have a student who has been offered a semester-long work-based learning placement, and before I can authorize the placement agreement, we need to review three areas: the host-site plan, supervision credentials, and family logistics. The draft plan currently lists Greenway Market on Tuesday and Thursday afternoons from 1:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m., with Ms. Lane as the school supervisor. I'd like to go through each area systematically. Could we start with the career-education teacher's review of the host-site plan? Then we'll hear from HR on supervision credentials, and finally the family liaison on family logistics. Once all three areas have reported, I'll record the revised plan and we can move toward authorization.

I recorded these trial results in my classroom notes this week but have not yet entered them into the placement file. I think this information is important for our review of the host-site plan.

transcript.text: I need to raise a critical issue on supervision credentials. District policy requires the on-site school supervisor for an off-campus placement to hold the work-based-learning supervision credential. I've verified that Ms. Lane does not hold this credential. However, Mr. Ortiz is the only available credentialed supervisor for this semester, and he is available for this placement. This means the draft plan's designation of Ms. Lane as the school supervisor cannot be authorized as it stands — Mr. Ortiz would need to be assigned as the supervisor instead.
